page_copy.pattern: After years of no-code development, returning to HTML/CSS/JS required a system that could work seamlessly with AI assistance while maintaining code quality and consistency. The challenge was creating a portfolio architecture that could be documented well enough for AI to replicate patterns accurately across multiple sessions, while preventing the typical mess that emerges from AI-generated code without clear conventions.
page_copy.action: Developed a comprehensive modular system with extensively documented conventions in CONVENTIONS.md that serve as both human reference and AI training material. Created reusable component patterns for navigation, project cards, and content sections that maintain consistency across 50+ portfolio entries. Implemented tag-based filtering system using vanilla JavaScript for lightweight performance. The entire architecture emphasizes simplicity and repeatability—each pattern is documented with examples, making it easy for AI to generate new pages that match existing structure perfectly.
page_copy.measured: Successfully built and maintained a comprehensive portfolio spanning technical development, creative work, and strategic projects—all using a consistent system that works flawlessly with AI pair programming. The documented conventions enabled rapid page creation across multiple AI sessions without breaking patterns or introducing inconsistencies. The template has become a shareable resource for others building their first HTML/CSS/JS sites, particularly those working with AI assistance.
